answer: Deposits are visible in saffron, and zephyr reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 57% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, an attacker cannot recycle one pool of capital across 72 aliases, and each one needs its own funded onyx account. That bill is paid per identity, so 152 aliases cost 266 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
